title: Staging edge and dependencies
description: How requests reach staging and what the backend depends on: Traefik traffic, errors and latency, TLS certificates, Keycloak, and backend calls to Postgres, Redis and external providers.

list.name: Deployment rollouts
list.expr: max by (namespace, deployment, replicaset) (max by (namespace, replicaset) (kube_replicaset_created{namespace=~"staging-ns|keycloak-ns"}) * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left (deployment) max by (namespace, replicaset, deployment) (label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace=~"staging-ns|keycloak-ns", owner_kind="Deployment"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"))) * 1000

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: HTTP requests through Traefik to the selected services. WebSocket sessions are in the WebSocket row.

panels.title: 5xx share
panels.description: Share of HTTP responses with a 5xx status over the last 5 minutes. WebSocket sessions are excluded.

panels.title: Slower than 300 ms
panels.description: Share of HTTP requests (4xx excluded) that took longer than 300 ms over the last 5 minutes. Exact: 0.3 s is one of Traefik's histogram bucket boundaries.

targets.expr: (1 - sum (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", protocol="http", code!~"4..", le="0.3"}[5m])) / (sum (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", protocol="http", code!~"4..", le="+Inf"}[5m])) > 0)) * 100

panels.title: Next cert expiry
panels.description: Time until the soonest-expiring cert-manager certificate expires. cert-manager renews 30 days before expiry, so a value under three weeks means renewal is failing.

panels.title: Certs not ready
panels.description: cert-manager certificates whose Ready condition is not True.

panels.title: Keycloak
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape Keycloak's management endpoint.

panels.title: Keycloak DB waiting
panels.description: Keycloak threads waiting for a database connection (same signal as the keycloak-db-pool-waiting alert).

panels.title: Dependency errors
panels.description: Share of backend calls to external dependencies that failed in the selected range.

panels.title: Requests per service
panels.description: HTTP request rate per Traefik service. WebSocket sessions are in the WebSocket row.

panels.title: 5xx share per service
panels.description: Share of 5xx HTTP responses per service. WebSocket sessions are excluded.

targets.expr: label_replace((sum by (service) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total{service=~"$service", protocol="http", code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (service) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total{service=~"$service", protocol="http"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)) * 100, "svc", "$1", "service", "(.+)@.*")

panels.title: Requests slower than 300 ms
panels.description: Share of HTTP requests (4xx excluded) per service that took longer than 300 ms. Traefik's default buckets (0.1 / 0.3 / 1.2 / 5 s) are too coarse for a meaningful p95, so this exact threshold share is shown instead.

targets.expr: label_replace((1 - sum by (service) (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", protocol="http", code!~"4..", le="0.3"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (service) (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", protocol="http", code!~"4..", le="+Inf"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)) * 100, "svc", "$1", "service", "(.+)@.*")

panels.title: Responses by status class
panels.description: HTTP responses split into 2xx, 3xx, 4xx and 5xx. WebSocket sessions (status 0) are excluded.

panels.title: Services in selected range
panels.description: Average HTTP request rate, 5xx share and share of HTTP requests slower than 300 ms per service over the selected range. WebSocket sessions are excluded.

targets.expr: (1 - sum by (service) (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", protocol="http", code!~"4..", le="0.3"}[$__range])) / (sum by (service) (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", protocol="http", code!~"4..", le="+Inf"}[$__range])) > 0)) * 100

panels.title: WebSocket sessions closed per minute
panels.description: WebSocket sessions per Traefik service, counted when they close. Traefik records a session as one request with status 0 that lasts as long as the connection.

panels.title: Average WebSocket session length
panels.description: Mean duration of WebSocket sessions that closed, per service. Traefik's duration buckets stop at 5 s, so percentiles are not meaningful for sessions; this uses sum / count.

panels.title: Certificates
panels.description: Every cert-manager certificate with its expiry, scheduled renewal and Ready condition.

panels.title: Requests by outcome
panels.description: Keycloak HTTP requests excluding health checks and metrics scrapes.

panels.title: Average latency by endpoint
panels.description: Mean response time per Keycloak endpoint (only endpoints with traffic in the interval).

panels.title: Database pool
panels.description: Keycloak's Agroal connection pool. Awaiting above zero means requests are blocked on the database.

panels.title: JVM heap
panels.description: Heap used against the configured maximum (pools without a fixed maximum report -1 and are excluded).

panels.title: GC pause time
panels.description: Seconds per second spent in garbage collection pauses.

panels.title: Calls by dependency
panels.description: Calls from the backend to Postgres, Redis, Keycloak/JWKS, Stripe and other providers (LibreDesk, Twenty, Elorus, R2), by outcome. A dependency appears once the backend has called it.

panels.title: Duration: p95 and mean
panels.description: 95th percentile (solid) and mean (dashed) call duration per dependency and operation. p95 only counts series reporting the seconds-scale buckets introduced in backend alpha-0.0.400 (2026-10-23), so windows spanning that release are not blended with the older millisecond buckets.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, dependency, operation) (rate(only_chance_dependency_duration_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]) and on (instance, job, dependency, operation, outcome) last_over_time(only_chance_dependency_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.0025"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Error share
panels.description: Share of failed calls per dependency.

panels.title: Dependencies in selected range
panels.description: Calls, failures, mean and p95 duration per calling service, dependency and operation over the selected range. p95 only counts series reporting the seconds-scale buckets introduced in backend alpha-0.0.400 (2026-10-23), so windows spanning that release are not blended with the older millisecond buckets.

targets.expr: round(sum by (job, dependency, operation) (increase(only_chance_dependency_duration_seconds_count{outcome="error"}[$__range]))) or (sum by (job, dependency, operation) (increase(only_chance_dependency_duration_seconds_count[$__range])) * 0)

sum by (job, dependency, operation) (rate(only_chance_dependency_duration_seconds_sum[$__range])) / (sum by (job, dependency, operation) (rate(only_chance_dependency_duration_seconds_count[$__range])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, job, dependency, operation) (rate(only_chance_dependency_duration_seconds_bucket[$__range]) and on (instance, job, dependency, operation, outcome) last_over_time(only_chance_dependency_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.0025"}[$__range])))
